name: claude-ai-course-backend
description: Cloudflare Worker API for the Claude AI Video Editing Course: Razorpay order creation + verification, Razorpay webhooks, single-use expiring PDF download tokens, private R2 storage and transactional email delivery.

scripts.secrets: echo 'Run: wrangler secret put RAZORPAY_KEY_ID   (repeat for each secret in .dev.vars.example)'
scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/razorpay.js && node --check src/email.js && node --check src/storage.js && node --check src/security.js

bindings.PDF_BUCKET: Private R2 bucket holding the course PDF
